processCorrections: Initial status and source batches exceeded the output budget; later reads used selected fields and bounded slices. The meta refresh printed historical metrics beyond this order; later meta output is retained in session scratch.
A read-only Git path glob had no zsh match; subsequent path searches quoted patterns or used discovered filenames.
Publication check correctly reported the source lock stale after the product edit. A premature recheck while sync was still running also failed; after awaiting sync, publication:check passed.

Comparing checkpoint 9 directly with the unstaged worktree misleadingly showed the two untracked source files as deleted. Review comparisons use the canonical complete working-tree snapshot, which includes them.
